suppressions.reason: readBadge parses untrusted Markdown and URL fields into BadgeSpec, validating source, colors, length, package names, and workflow names before use.
The upstream JSON parser validates object shapes, nonempty bounded version strings, and nonnegative integer downloads before rendering; malformed responses become unavailable badges.
isEntry validates the JSON read back from the shared cache, which any version of the handler may have written, before it is served; anything else counts as a miss.
